ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a bed for {OTHER_nameDef} in {PAWN_possessive} room
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist bonded to a small animal wants it sleeping in their room, not out with the herd.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: An animal bed or sleeping spot in {PAWN_nameDef}'s bedroom.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} sleeps outside my door every night anyway. Might as well be inside it.
Just a corner for {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll clean up the hair. Most of it.
[winter] It's freezing in the barn. {OTHER_nameDef} could sleep at the foot of my bed. Please.
[night] I woke up and {OTHER_nameDef} wasn't there. I didn't sleep again.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} looks after me all day. Let me look after {OTHER_objective} at night.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} sleeps with me. Build a bed or I'll share mine.

cheerful.li: A little bed for {OTHER_nameDef}! With a blanket! Maybe a tiny pillow! Is a tiny pillow too much?

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is the only one who's never let me down. The least I can do is keep {OTHER_objective} close.

cold.li: A bonded animal near its handler sleeps better and works better. So do I.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} turned three times and lay down like {OTHER_pronoun} owned the place. Which, now, fair.

warm.li: Listen to {OTHER_nameDef} snore. Best sound in the colony.

cheerful.li: Look at {OTHER_objective}! In {OTHER_possessive} little bed! I'm not crying. Okay, a bit.

plain.li: Back to the barn, then. {OTHER_nameDef} looked at me like it was my fault.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {OTHER_nameDef} patched up
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist's bonded animal is hurt, and they won't rest until it's tended and back on its feet.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is bleeding and nobody's looked at {OTHER_objective}. Somebody. Please.
I know animals aren't priority. {OTHER_nameDef} is my priority.
[afterraid] {OTHER_nameDef} fought for us too. Patch {OTHER_objective} up like you'd patch me.

warm.li: Could a doctor see {OTHER_nameDef}? I'll do anyone's chores for a week.

blunt.li: Get a doctor to {OTHER_nameDef}. Now. I'll wait. Not long.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is being so brave! Let's fix {OTHER_objective} up so I can stop pretending I'm brave too!

gloomy.li: If {OTHER_nameDef} dies because nobody bothered, I don't know what I'll do.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is a trained asset. An untended wound means losing the training. Fix it.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is up and limping around like nothing happened. Thank you.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} licked my face. That's from both of us.

gloomy.li: Still here. Both of us. That's more than I expected.

plain.li: I sat with {OTHER_nameDef} all night. Nobody else came.
